records.disposition: Seven-step biosynthetic route from erythrose 4-phosphate/phosphoenolpyruvate to chorismate. Shared 3-dehydroquinate dehydration and shikimate intermediates do not cover quinate oxidation to protocatechuate.
WikiPathways GPML biosynthetic and Ehrlich context ending at 2-phenylethanol. Shikimate and chorismate occur upstream; no quinate-to-protocatechuate pathway boundary.
Ten-transformation siderophore pathway uses shared dehydroshikimate-to-protocatechuate RHEA:24849 and AsbF complex. It does not include quinate or shikimate initial catabolic oxidation.

incidental_numeric_substrings: Raw numeric Rhea IDs can appear within unrelated PMID identifiers, so substring counts are not exact pathway membership.
